joinedLine: I collected for him. Now I will carry your name.
grudgeLine: I am still backing you. Keep your bumper off my crew.

joinedLine: The missing wages bought his fleet. My crew backs your climb.
grudgeLine: We share a cause. That does not make my steel yours to break.

joinedLine: I can sell a fast car. I cannot sell you out.
grudgeLine: You took my line. Earn the next one clean.

joinedLine: Every crew has the books. Take our names to the Crown.
grudgeLine: I kept the evidence safe. Keep my driver safe too.
